title: Freshdesk Review (2026)
intro: Freshdesk is evaluated here as a helpdesk / ticketing platform — Freshdesk is Freshworks' helpdesk and omnichannel support platform for ticket queues, shared inboxes, SLAs, automations, and knowledge-base deflection. Annual per-agent pricing (USD): Growth $19, Pro $55, Enterprise $89 per agent/month billed annually. 14-day free trial on paid tiers. Part of the Freshworks suite alongside Freshchat and Freshservice — scored as helpdesk-ticketing primary. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse's customer-service methodology (ease of use, support job fit, workflow depth, omnichannel, self-service, integrations, analytics, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Freshdesk when helpdesk ticketing with omnichannel inbox depth is the primary job and you want Freshworks ecosystem alignment at a mid-market price floor.
verdict: Choose Freshdesk when helpdesk ticketing with omnichannel inbox depth is the primary job and you want Freshworks ecosystem alignment at a mid-market price floor. Compare Zendesk Suite for enterprise omnichannel scale, Help Scout for SMB shared-inbox simplicity, and Zoho Desk for budget suite-adjacent helpdesk pricing. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

faq.question: How is Freshdesk priced?

faq.question: Does Freshdesk have a free plan or free trial?
faq.answer: No free plan is published. A free trial is documented (about 14 days). Confirm current terms with the vendor.

faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage. Affiliate relationships never influence scores.
